info.short_description: Adjusted enrollment count reported at the reporting level.
info.long_description: OHA's "Documentation Required (Adjusted Enrollment)" count, used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

info.long_name: Number of students up to date for all required vaccines
info.short_description: Number of assessed school students up to date for all required vaccines.
info.long_description: Count of assessed school students who have completed every age-appropriate required immunization, from OHA's "With All Vaccines Required" column.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} school students were up to date for all required vaccines.

info.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for all required vaccines
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students up to date for all required vaccines.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students who have completed every age-appropriate required immunization (fully immunized / up to date at the time of the survey).
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for all required vaccines.

info.long_name: Number of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Number of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption from vaccination requirements.
info.long_description: Count of assessed school students holding a nonmedical exemption from at least one required vaccine, from OHA's "Nonmedical Exemptions Any Vaccines" column.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption from vaccination requirements.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a nonmedical exemption from at least one required vaccine. OHA reports this as a single figure across all series rather than split by vaccine.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Number of students exempt from DTaP/Tdap vaccination

info.statement: In {location}, {value} school students were exempt from DTaP/Tdap vaccination.

info.long_name: Proportion of students exempt from DTaP/Tdap vaccination

info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding an exemption of any kind from the DTaP/Tdap series. or_school_immunization.name: Oregon School Immunization Coverage, K-12
or_school_immunization.organization: Oregon Health Authority, Public Health Division
or_school_immunization.description: Statewide K-12 school immunization workbook published each fall by the Oregon Health Authority (OHA). Every row is one school, carrying the county (Agency), adjusted enrollment, a count and percent exempt for each required vaccine, the share up to date on all required vaccines, and the share with a nonmedical exemption from any vaccine. County-level rows are derived by summing the school-level counts and recomputing shares from those sums. OHA overwrites the workbook at a fixed URL each year, so the series is self-updating.
or_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the Oregon Health Authority; no access restrictions. County values are derived aggregates of school-level counts and may differ slightly from any official county figures OHA reports separately. Schools with fewer than 10 students in the adjusted enrollment are suppressed by OHA and carry no counts.
